why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.the_recorded_reason_was_wrong: The recorded reason reads: 'its registered primaries are SAFETY outcomes -- treatment-emergent adverse events and events of special interest -- not cardiovascular events.' That is FACTUALLY WRONG. NCT02666664 registers THIRTEEN primary outcomes and the SECOND is 'Percentage of Participants With Adjudicated Major Adverse Cardiovascular Event'. It has a MACE primary.
why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.how_the_error_happened: The object stores `registered_primary_measure` as a SCALAR holding ONE of the trial's thirteen primaries -- the first, TEAEs -- and the exclusion reason was written by characterising all primaries from that single value. why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.the_verdict_still_stands_but_on_a_differ: EXCLUDE is still correct. The failing limb is POPULATION, not OUTCOME: this is CLEAR Harmony, in high-cardiovascular-risk patients on maximally tolerated statin therapy, whereas the review's population limb is statin-intolerant patients.
why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.class: A correct verdict reached by broken reasoning. It passed every outcome-based check because the outcome -- exclusion -- was right. Only reading the REASON against the registry caught it, and only because the withholding question is asked at every rank rather than at the primary alone.

studies.name: CLEAR Serenity
studies.why_not_contributing: its registered primary is PERCENT CHANGE IN LDL-C AT WEEK 12, a laboratory value. Correctly excluded from a MACE estimate.
studies.registered_primary_measure: Percent Change From Baseline (PCFB) in Low-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at Week 12
studies.registered_primary_description_verbatim: PCFB was calculated as the (\[post-Baseline (BL) value minus the BL value\] divided by the BL value ) x 100. BL was defined as the mean of the last two non-missing values on or prior to Day 1. If only one value was available, that single value was used as BL. PCFB in LDL-C was analyzed using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA), with treatment group and stratification factor (primary prevention; secondary prevention) as fixed effects and BL as a covariate. For participants with missing lipid data at Week 12 who were no longer taking study treatment, missing values were imputed using multiple imputation via a regression-based model including stratification and BL data from placebo participants only. In this imputation model, treatment group was not included. For participants with missing lipid data at Week 12 who were still taking study treatment, missing values were imputed using multiple imputation via a regression-based model including treatment, stratification and BL value.

pooled.stands_because: THE ESTIMATE STANDS, AND IT IS ONE TRIAL'S RESULT RATHER THAN A SYNTHESIS -- which the card says, with k=1. HR 0.87 (0.79 to 0.96) IS CLEAR Outcomes' own registered Cox analysis, digit for digit, over its registered primary outcome: 'Number of Participants With First Occurrence of Four Component Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (MACE)', defined by its registry record as 'death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or coronary revascularization, as assessed in a time-to first-event analysis'. Its counts are the registry's own: 819 of 6,992 against 927 of 6,978. AND k=1 IS CORRECT RATHER THAN A SHORTFALL. Of the four registrations this page includes, ONLY CLEAR Outcomes registers a cardiovascular-event primary. CLEAR Harmony's registered primaries are SAFETY endpoints -- treatment-emergent adverse events and events of special interest, at 52 weeks. CLEAR Serenity's is PERCENT CHANGE IN LDL-C AT WEEK 12, a laboratory value. Neither can enter a MACE estimate, so leaving them out is right; what is missing is any statement that they were left out or why.
pooled.caveats: THREE THINGS A READER SHOULD KNOW, NONE OF WHICH OVERTURNS THE ESTIMATE. (1) ONE OF THE FOUR INCLUDED REGISTRATIONS IS NOT A BEMPEDOIC ACID TRIAL AT ALL. NCT02973841 is 'Sono-ease', a FORTY-PATIENT DEVICE STUDY of internal jugular vein cannulation whose registered primary outcome is 'complications rate'. It sits in this page's own include list. It carries no data record, so it touches no number here -- but it is the second wrong registration found in this corpus in one session, after NCT02583191 turned out to be a German treatment-satisfaction study on DOAC_CANCER_VTE. A registration that names an unrelated trial is invisible to every check that asks only whether an id is present and unique. (2) THE PUBLISHED-COMPARISON STEP COMPARES THIS ESTIMATE AGAINST ITSELF. The page's benchmark database holds exactly one entry for this outcome: 'CLEAR Outcomes bempedoic acid vs placebo', Nissen 2023, HR 0.87 (0.79 to 0.96), k=1, n=13,970. That IS the trial whose result is on the card. A comparison of a number with itself agrees perfectly and establishes NOTHING, and the agreement should not be read as external corroboration. THE HONEST DENOMINATOR HERE IS ZERO: no independent synthesis of this estimand is recorded on this page. (3) A SINGLE TRIAL IS NOT A SYNTHESIS. Nothing here is pooled, there is no heterogeneity to report, and the interval is CLEAR Outcomes' own. The value of this page over reading the trial report is the provenance chain, not the statistics.
pooled.card_note: k=1 and that is CORRECT, not a shortfall: only CLEAR Outcomes registers a cardiovascular-event primary. The value is the registry's own Cox analysis. One of the four included registrations, NCT02973841, is NOT a bempedoic acid trial

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

reconciliation.gap_stated_plainly: 16 CTGov trials place bempedoic acid in an EXPERIMENTAL arm. THE ROUTE FROM 17 TO 16 IS NOT WHAT THIS SENTENCE USED TO SAY, and it took re-deriving across every revision of the classifier to see it -- scripts/regate_across_revisions.py. It went 17 -> 15 at 92d84da72, where the both-arms rule moved NCT06450366 and NCT07614958 experimental -> background; then 15 -> 16 at f2bf16022, where the placebo-discriminator moved NCT05263778 comparator -> EXPERIMENTAL. The old sentence credited the placebo-discriminator with the whole delta and described its one move in the OPPOSITE direction. Then at e20f94068 the same two records moved background -> COMPARATOR, leaving k3 at 16 and background at 0. This object includes ONE. All fifteen of the rest have been SCREENED -- fourteen in the first pass and NCT05263778 in a second, after the restatement moved it into the experimental set -- and none was both eligible and poolable. The unscreened remainder is 0.
reconciliation.background_is_now_zero_and_it_is_compute: 0 background is the result of classifying 21 records, not an unfilled field. P17: a field whose name implies a check carries a computed value.

restated_2026_08_19_placebo_discriminato.why: topic_identity.locate() read the registry's arm TYPES literally. Some registrations declare NO arm typed EXPERIMENTAL: AFFIRM-AHF and HEART-FID both type their active drug ACTIVE_COMPARATOR against a PLACEBO_COMPARATOR arm. The classifier called the intervention a comparator and silently shrank the evidence base. Rule adopted: PLACEBO IS NEVER THE INTERVENTION, so a drug compared against it is -- but where the other arm is an ACTIVE drug, the topic drug genuinely is one of two comparators and the rule must not fire.
restated_2026_08_19_placebo_discriminato.why_this_is_a_correction_not_a_relaxatio: It moved counts in BOTH directions across the corpus: sglt2-hf +10, bempedoic-acid-review -1. risk_of_bias.tool: RoB 2 (Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials)
risk_of_bias.version: 22 August 2019 version, as reproduced in the Cochrane Handbook
risk_of_bias.handbook: Higgins JPT, Savovic J, Page MJ, Elbers RG, Sterne JAC. Chapter 8: Assessing risk of bias in a randomized trial. In: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions version 6.5.1
risk_of_bias.unit_of_assessment: A RESULT, not a study -- Handbook 8.2: 'risk of bias is assessed for a specific result'. Every judgement below names its outcome.
risk_of_bias.default_rule: A domain that cannot be judged from the registration and the published report is NO_INFORMATION, never LOW. Low-by-default asserts a fact; high-by-default invents a defect.

ceiling.statement: NO RESULT IN THIS REVIEW CAN REACH LOW RISK OF BIAS ON THE EVIDENCE WE CAN REACH, AND THAT IS A FACT ABOUT OUR ACCESS RATHER THAN ABOUT THE TRIALS. The two domains that would distinguish LOW from SOME CONCERNS need documents this review does not hold: D1 needs allocation concealment and baseline data, which are in neither the registration nor the published abstract; D5 needs the trial's statistical analysis plan, which is not held for any trial. SOME CONCERNS IS THEREFORE THE CEILING, NOT A FINDING. A trial rated SOME CONCERNS here may well be at low risk of bias -- we cannot show it, and we do not imply the opposite.
ceiling.what_would_change_it: Retrieving each trial's full published report and its statistical analysis plan or protocol. Until then the rating is bounded by what we read, and the bound is reported rather than the reader inferring it.
ceiling.why_this_is_stated_rather_than_left_impl: A rating of SOME CONCERNS with no explanation reads as a judgement against the trial. Omitting the reason would manufacture a criticism exactly as a low-by-default manufactures a reassurance -- the same defect pointed the other way.

evidence: Allocation concealment and baseline-imbalance data are in neither the registration nor the fields this object holds.
No trial's statistical analysis plan is held, so whether this analysis was pre-specified cannot be established. D5 therefore cannot reach LOW.

k = 1. The interval (0.79 to 0.96) does not cross the null, but at k = 1 tau-squared is estimated from almost no information and a random-effects interval is optimistic even when it looks tight. Rated down for a small contributing set rather than reporting the number as if it were robust.

k = 1. A funnel plot and Egger's test have no power below k = 10, so publication bias is UNDETECTED rather than ABSENT. Not rated down, and not reported as clean: an unreachable state is not a passing one.

protocol.why: A protocol specified before data collection is a HISTORICAL FACT ABOUT THE PAST and cannot be created retrospectively. Writing one now and calling it prespecified would invalidate every other refusal on these pages, because a reader who caught it would be right to disbelieve all of them.
protocol.what_was_actually_done: Eligibility criteria were derived POST HOC from the trials and the methodological authority, and the derivation is recorded element by element in `screening.eligibility_provenance` with the source of each.
protocol.authority_permitting_it: MECIR R107 permits post-hoc eligibility criteria PROVIDED THEY ARE DECLARED AS SUCH. They are declared, here and on the page, and the page says 'derived, post hoc' in its heading.
protocol.forward_remedy: For topics not yet built, a protocol is to be written and registered BEFORE the search is executed, so that the claim becomes true GOING FORWARD. It is never to be made true retroactively for a built topic.
